items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: And that same Willie Humphrey, Daddy, used to play a sax.

ctx.x: He know how he looked like a little Mexican. He was bigger than me. Short. Just like me. But he's heavenly to me. And I used to like the other man to play the trumpet. I used to say... That time... I was talking about second line prayer. I used to like second line prayer by them kind of fellas. But that time, they had old George Washington. Do you ever know where the George Washington... Trombone? Trombone play. He's about that like. About that big. I never saw him, though. That big. And that same Willie…
